messages:
Mai Tran: Heads up — compact compare rows prototype: action chevrons overlap performance badge tooltip when density="tight". screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/compact-overlap.png :eyes:
Jordan Lee: I noticed that. tooltip clipped and keyboard focus order is wonky when tabbing actions
Sanjay Patel: can repro. need steps so I can patch locally
Mai Tran: Steps: Catalog > View: Compact > hover perf badge in right column > hover chevron next to it. Tooltip appears behind the chevron button
Carmen Ruiz: cc @UX-bot this reads like a z-index / a11y issue. Also tooltip copy says "perf score" — prefer "latency · cost" for clarity
UX-bot: Suggestion: tooltip copy: "Perf (latency · cost)". Increase tooltip z-index to 1200. Add 100ms show delay to reduce flicker on quick hovers
Jordan Lee: 100ms show delay fine, 300ms hide delay? keep it short so it doesn't stick when moving to actions
Sanjay Patel: Implementation note: action chevrons render in a portal for overflow, so stacking context is different. Quick fixes: render badges/actions in same stacking context, or give action portal explicit z-index and toggle aria-hidden while tooltip is open
Mai Tran: screen reader behavior: when tabbing the badge, tooltip appears but disappears before SR reads it. Thoughts?
Carmen Ruiz: tooltips are visual only. Add aria-label on badge with full text like: "Performance: 92 — latency 120ms, cost $0.002/token" and use an offscreen live region for dynamic updates
Jordan Lee: also compact chevron hit target is 18px. bump to 24px min per a11y
Sanjay Patel: quick CSS I tested:
.catalog-row .action-portal { z-index: 1200; }
.tooltip { transition-delay: 100ms; transition-duration: 140ms; }
.action-button { min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; }
Seems to fix overlap locally
Mai Tran: great. open a small PR with that and add aria-label change. also update tooltip copy in components/tooltip/strings.ts
Jordan Lee: on version pinning: when rows collapse badges in compact mode the pin icon disappears. we should surface a persistent affordance — maybe a small left stripe or dot so pinned rows remain obvious
Carmen Ruiz: +1. left 2px stripe with pin color in compact mode. ensure accessible contrast
UX-bot: Accessibility check: left stripe must meet 3:1 contrast ratio at compact widths. fallback to 4px stripe or a tiny icon badge if contrast fails
Mai Tran: plan: stripe visible normally, show pin icon on hover, add aria-pressed state on row for pinned. Jordan add tests for keyboard order and a11y notes in PR
Jordan Lee: will do — will include screenshots and automated keyboard test
Sanjay Patel: tagging @eng-frontend for visibility :thumbsup:
Mai Tran: thanks all. I'll follow up in design tokens review tomorrow for copy update
